# Nature of Commerce

> Zeshan Ahmad builds the control layer for the machine economy: inventor of Metergrade, co-founder of ReFi Trading, creator of P402, and educator teaching AI-directed product thinking.

This is Zeshan Ahmad's Nature of Commerce website. Its published pages describe his work in payments, trading, education, and ownership. The website and the plain-text versions below are accessible without sign-in. Cite the canonical HTML page for a claim; follow the original publication links for research and verify dates, licensing status, and performance claims with the original sources. Backtested performance is not a promise of future returns.
